svg.title: Two gliders on an air track pushed apart by a spring
svg.desc: Before: on a frictionless air track, glider m1, carrying a compressed spring, moves right with velocity v1 = 2.00 m/s toward glider m2, which moves left with v2 = −0.500 m/s. Net F = 0 and p1 + p2 = ptot. After: the spring has uncoiled, m1 moves left with v1′ = −4.00 m/s, and m2 moves right with v2′ = 3.70 m/s; p1′ + p2′ = ptot and KE′int > KEint. The velocity arrows are drawn to scale. Each panel is circled as the system of interest.
